uses.quote: the proof-reader or proof reading tool must only identify potential changes which you must then choose to accept or reject; this will ensure that you remain the author of your work.

decided_by.quote: Your assessments will fall into one of the following three categories.
Each assessment brief will state clearly which one of the categories applies.
if you have any doubts as to the extent to which genAI use may be allowed in an assessment, please always speak to the module leader.

duty.quote: If you use AI in an assessment, you must disclose your use in line with the requirements of your assessment brief.
